product.name: Taskade
product.category: AI 协作 / 任务与 Agent 平台
product.one_liner: 一个工作区里同时有项目、文档、思维导图、AI agent 与自动化；还能一键克隆别人的成品 app
product.icp_primary: 小团队 / 一人公司 / 代理机构
product.jtbd: 把任务、笔记、AI 执行和自动化放在同一个工作区，且能直接克隆成品开始
product.core_scenarios: 项目与任务 / 文档 / 思维导图 / AI agent / 自动化 / 生成与转换 / 社区 app 克隆
product.ai_mode: 原生（AI-first：TSK-1 智能层 + AI agents + MCP）
product.pricing_model: Freemium + 订阅（个人/团队/企业档，价格以定价页为准）
product.free_tier: Free $0 永久：2 个成员、3 个 Genesis app、1 个 agent、10 次自动化/月、1 个知识源；无月度 credits（靠邀请获得）
product.paid_tiers: Starter $6；Pro $10（月付 $20）；Business $25；Max $100；Enterprise $250（均为年付折算月价，年付省 50%）
product.primary_channels: 程序化 SEO 28,602 页（程序化 64.2% / UGC 21.4% / 手写 14.3%）+ UGC 克隆 6,135 页 + llms.txt / MCP 的 AI 原生发现 + 155 页 free-竞品-alternative
product.moat_hypothesis: 模板 × 同一数据模型 × 克隆：一个对象图，四种封装（项目/agent/自动化/app）

template_fit.for_whom: SaaS / Web 产品的研发与 QA 团队
template_fit.scenario: 缺陷从登记、分级、回归到发布说明的全流程
template_fit.how_to_use: Clone this template into your Taskade workspace → Customize the severity rubric and status pipeline for your team's process → Connect GitHub or Linear so commits and PRs sync to bug records → Train the Triage Agent on your past bugs and severity definitions → Set up automation triggers for P0 escalation to Slack and weekly bug-burn reports
template_fit.value: Triage in 30 seconds, not 30 minutes: The AI Triage Agent reads new bugs and assigns severity + owner in seconds — your engineers stop spending Monday morning in triage meetings → Regression history is one search away: "Has this stack trace appeared before?" returns matching past bugs across the entire release history — Memory across releases means engineers don't fix the same bug twice → Customer impact visible to PMs: Every bug links to affected customers and their plan tier, so PMs prioritize based on revenue impact, not just severity
template_fit.what_it_is: Bug tracker for SaaS and web product teams with AI severity scoring, GitHub PR sync, browser/OS field tracking, and regression search across past releases.
template_fit.fit_basis: 适合谁/场景=推断（基于模板描述与模块）；怎么用/价值=原文

Shift $30K from LinkedIn to content next quarter" — your CMO makes data-driven calls instead of channel-by-vibe defenses → Attribution that sales agrees with: Multi-touch attribution + first/last touch comparison. When sales asks "did marketing actually drive this deal?" the dashboard shows the full touch sequence → Plan stays alive: Most SaaS marketing plans get presented at QBR and forgotten. This plan publishes campaigns, tracks performance, and re-plans every quarter
